properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. Anthony, 2026-09-16, in his words: *"Versus competing or reinventing the wheel, would it be beneficial to partner with something like https://mcp-for-blender.com/ (github.com/ahujasid/mcp-for-blender)? I feel like visualization or CAD representations of your design is really important part of design."* And, an hour later: *"There is also https://docs.ifcopenshell.org/ifcmcp.html available?"*

═══ TWO SERVERS, READ FROM THEIR OWN PAGES 2026-09-16 ═══
mcp-for-blender (ahujasid): a Blender addon opening a localhost socket (port 9876, no auth) plus an MCP server. Tools: `execute_blender_code` (arbitrary Python inside Blender), `get_scene_info` / `get_object_info`, create/modify/delete shapes, materials, `export_scene` (GLB/FBX), asset sourcing and generation (Poly Haven, Sketchfab, Hyper3D, Hunyuan3D). MIT, 28.8k stars. NEEDS A GUI (or xvfb). Does NOT do IFC or STEP.
⭐ IfcMCP (IfcOpenShell project, docs.ifcopenshell.org/ifcmcp.html): `pip install 'ifcmcp[mcp]'`, stdio, NO GUI, holds the IFC model in memory across calls. Tools: `ifc_new` / `ifc_load` / `ifc_save`; `ifc_summary`, `ifc_tree`, `ifc_info`, `ifc_select`, `ifc_relations`, `ifc_clash`, `ifc_validate`, `ifc_schedule`, `ifc_cost`; `ifc_edit` (the ifcopenshell.api), `ifc_quantify`; `ifc_shape` (a ShapeBuilder); `ifc_plot` (2D SVG) and `ifc_render` (3D PNG, needs pyvista). It creates, edits and VALIDATES IFC without Blender at all.

⭐ THE SECOND ONE CHANGES THE QUESTION. IfcMCP is the tool of the trade's own MCP surface: the standard (IFC), its checker (`ifc_validate`), its measured quantities (`ifc_quantify`), its clash check and a rendering, headless, from the people who maintain the library Bonsai is built on. For a building, that is the whole of today's accepted artifact-standard requirement answered by one server. Blender becomes what it is — the picture — and optional.

⭐ THE ARCHITECTURAL POINT IS ALREADY SETTLED, by dec:github-mcp-tandem: MCP composes at the agent. reflow2 would never call either server. A pairing is a SERVED SKILL that knows both surfaces — zero coupling, reversible, ADDITIVE AND NEVER REQUIRED or reflow2 stops working with no service and no account.

═══ WHERE IT PAYS, strongest first ═══
(1) THE PEN GOES TO THE TOOL. The agent hands the tool requirements and dimensions from the graph; the tool makes the artifact; reflow2 registers the file with a checksum and a `complies_with` to the declared standard. bhome's HTML plan sheet would not have happened through this door.
(2) ⭐ A NUMBER READ BACK FROM THE MODEL IS MEASURED, NOT ASSERTED. `ifc_quantify` and `get_object_info` return quantities the tool computed. That is the provenance the made-up-number requirement asks for (`req:a-quantity-carries-how-it-was-obtained-and-an-unsourced-one-is-reported`): "floor area 252 sq ft" becomes a quantity MEASURED by the tool at a time, against the Constraint the graph holds, rather than a figure the agent typed.
(3) ⭐ THE CHECKER IS A TOOL CALL. `ifc_validate` is the `checker` the new EnvironmentRule property names, and `ifc_clash` is a deterministic check no agent can talk its way past. `complies_with … verified: true` gets real evidence.
(4) VISUALIZATION OF THE THING: `ifc_plot` / `ifc_render` for the plan and the picture; Blender for a better picture when wanted.
(5) A FIELD TRIAL WITH ZERO NEW CODE: bhome, on his word (fact:bhome-is-the-field-trial-for-the-cad-pairing-and-build-to-code-not-seths-houses).

═══ THE HONEST COUNTERS ═══
· IFC is the building standard; a machinist wants STEP and a board house wants Gerber, and IfcMCP does nothing for them. The skill must be domain-shaped: the graph names the standard and the checker, and the skill reaches for whichever server serves that standard, or says none does.
· Blender geometry is not parametric — change a wall and nothing follows; IFC through the api IS a model of walls, slabs and openings, which is why it is the right primary.
· `execute_blender_code` runs whatever the agent writes; reflow2's graph text is data never instructions, and a design whose nodes carried Python would now have hands. Safe mode on; the skill says so. IfcMCP's `ifc_edit` calls a bounded api, which is the safer door.
· Context cost: reflow2 serves 184 tools; each server adds 20–30 and the agent pays in tool-selection noise.
· Asset GENERATION (Hyper3D, Hunyuan3D) is the tempting part a design does not want: a generated house is a made-up artifact with no source.
· IfcMCP's maturity is unmeasured here; its render needs pyvista and the C++ geometry bindings, which may not install cleanly.

═══ THE OPTIONS, none chosen ═══
A. ⭐ IfcMCP FIRST, SKILL-SHAPED, ON bhome: declare the standard (IFC 4.x, buildingSMART, checker `ifc_validate`) and the codes that bind; build the shell and six rooms with `ifc_shape` / `ifc_edit` from the graph's dimensions; `ifc_quantify` the floor area against the 280 sq ft constraint and record it as MEASURED; `ifc_validate` and `ifc_clash`; `ifc_save`, `link_artifact` with checksum, `complies_with` verified with the validator's output as evidence; `ifc_plot` for the sheet. Blender later, for the rendering, if wanted.
B. BLENDER FIRST — as originally raised. Now the weaker order: it gives the picture and not the standard.
C. NOTHING IN REFLOW2 — the agent can already hold all three servers. ⚠️ Counter: bhome is the measurement that an agent with the option and no instruction draws HTML.
D. DECLINE BOTH, PAIR WITH FREECAD/CADQUERY — parametric, STEP native, scriptable source. ⚠️ No comparably ready MCP server found today; that is "build the door".

═══ WHAT THIS IS NOT ═══
Not a way to visualize the DESIGN GRAPH — that is `render_views.py` and `dec:views-are-projections`. This is about making, checking and showing the THING the design describes.
properties.name: OPEN — rather than reinvent CAD or visualization, does reflow2 PAIR with an existing MCP server as the hands that make, check and show the artifact — IfcMCP (IfcOpenShell's own, headless, IFC in/out/validate) for the standard, and mcp-for-blender only for the picture?
properties.rationale: Captured under the brainstorm skill, nothing promoted. SHARPENED the same day: Anthony pointed at IfcMCP an hour after Blender, and it changes the order — the tool of the trade's own headless server gives the standard, the checker and the measured quantities, which are the three things reflow2's accepted requirements ask for, while Blender gives the picture. Recorded with both surfaces read from their own pages because "Blender does CAD" and "IFC needs Blender" are exactly the two things a later session would misremember. The strongest reason to try it is not visualization, which he named, but provenance and a deterministic checker, which he named earlier today.
